import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';

void main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  await Firebase.initializeApp(
    options: const FirebaseOptions(
      apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY",
      appId: "YOUR_APP_ID",
      messagingSenderId: "YOUR_SENDER_ID",
      projectId: "YOUR_PROJECT_ID",
    ),
  );
  runApp(const MyApp());
}

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const MyApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      title: 'KCA Smart Queue',
      theme: ThemeData(primaryColor: const Color(0xFF0A2A6B), textTheme: GoogleFonts.poppinsTextTheme()),
      home: const AuthScreen(),
    );
  }
}

// 0. LOGIN SCREEN - Only Staff can login
class AuthScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AuthScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<AuthScreen> createState() => _AuthScreenState();
}
class _AuthScreenState extends State<AuthScreen> {
  final email = TextEditingController();
  final password = TextEditingController();

  void login() async {
    try {
      await FirebaseAuth.instance.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email: email.text, password: password.text);
      Navigator.pushReplacement(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const RoleScreen()));
    } catch(e){ ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("Login Failed: $e"))); }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text("KCA Smart Queue Login"), backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0A2A6B)),
      body: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, children: [
          Image.asset('assets/kca_logo.png', height: 100), // ADD KCA LOGO HERE
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          TextField(controller: email, decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: "Staff Email", border: OutlineInputBorder())),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          TextField(controller: password, obscureText: true, decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: "Password", border: OutlineInputBorder())),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          ElevatedButton(onPressed: login, style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0A2A6B), minimumSize: const Size(200, 50)), child: const Text("LOGIN AS STAFF")),
          TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const RoleScreen(isStudent: true))), child: const Text("Continue as Student/Display"))
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ROLE SCREEN
class RoleScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool isStudent;
  const RoleScreen({super.key, this.isStudent = false});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text("KCA Smart Queue"), backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0A2A6B)),
      body: Center(
        child: Column(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, children: [
          if(!isStudent) _roleBtn(context, "Staff Dashboard", Icons.badge, Colors.green, const StaffScreen()),
          _roleBtn(context, "Student", Icons.person, Colors.blue, const StudentScreen()),
          _roleBtn(context, "Display Screen", Icons.tv, Colors.red, const DisplayScreen()),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
  Widget _roleBtn(context, text, icon, color, page) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
      child: ElevatedButton.icon(
        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: color, minimumSize: const Size(250, 60)),
        icon: Icon(icon, size: 30), label: Text(text, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
        onPressed: () => Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => page)),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// 1. STUDENT SCREEN - WITH QUEUE NUMBER
class StudentScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const StudentScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<StudentScreen> createState() => _StudentScreenState();
}
class _StudentScreenState extends State<StudentScreen> {
  final name = TextEditingController();
  final reg = TextEditingController();
  String service = "Finance";
  String myStatus = "";

  void requestQueue() async {
    // GET NEXT QUEUE NUMBER
    var snap = await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('queue_requests').where('status', whereIn: ['pending','approved','serving']).get();
    int nextNumber = snap.docs.length + 1;

    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('queue_requests').add({
      'name': name.text, 'regNo': reg.text, 'service': service,
      'queueNumber': nextNumber,
      'status': 'pending', 'requestedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
    });
    setState(() => myStatus = "Request Sent! Your Queue No: $nextNumber");
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text("Student Portal"), backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0A2A6B)),
      body: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(children: [
          TextField(controller: name, decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: "Full Name", border: OutlineInputBorder())),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          TextField(controller: reg, decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: "Reg No", border: OutlineInputBorder())),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          DropdownButtonFormField(value: service, decoration: const InputDecoration(border: OutlineInputBorder()),
            items: ["Finance","Exams","HOD"].map((e)=>DropdownMenuItem(value: e, child: Text(e))).toList(),
            onChanged: (v)=>setState(()=>service=v!)),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          ElevatedButton(onPressed: requestQueue, style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0A2A6B)), child: const Text("REQUEST NUMBER")),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          Text(myStatus, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.green, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// 2. STAFF SCREEN - WITH "CALL NEXT"
class StaffScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const StaffScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text("Staff Dashboard"), backgroundColor: Colors.green),
      body: Column(children: [
        // CURRENTLY SERVING
        StreamBuilder(
          stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('queue_requests').where('status', isEqualTo: 'serving').limit(1).snapshots(),
          builder: (context, snap) {
            if (!snap.hasData || snap.data!.docs.isEmpty) return const ListTile(title: Text("No one being served"));
            var doc = snap.data!.docs.first;
            return Card(color: Colors.yellow[100],
              child: ListTile(
                title: Text("NOW SERVING: ${doc['queueNumber']}. ${doc['name']}", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 18)),
                trailing: ElevatedButton(onPressed: ()=>doc.reference.update({'status':'done'}), child: const Text("DONE")),
              ),
            );
          }
        ),
        // PENDING/APPROVED LIST
        Expanded(
          child: StreamBuilder(
            stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('queue_requests').where('status', whereIn: ['pending','approved']).orderBy('requestedAt').snapshots(),
            builder: (context, snap) {
              if (!snap.hasData) return const CircularProgressIndicator();
              return ListView(
                children: snap.data!.docs.map((doc) => Card(
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: CircleAvatar(child: Text(doc['queueNumber'].toString())),
                    title: Text(doc['name']),
                    subtitle: Text("${doc['regNo']} - ${doc['service']} - ${doc['status']}"),
                    trailing: doc['status'] == 'pending'
                     ? IconButton(icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.green), onPressed: ()=>doc.reference.update({'status':'approved'}))
                      : ElevatedButton(onPressed: ()=>doc.reference.update({'status':'serving'}), child: const Text("CALL NEXT"))
                  ),
                )).toList(),
              );
            }
          ),
        )
      ]),
    );
  }
}

// 3. DISPLAY SCREEN - WITH BIG QUEUE NUMBER
class DisplayScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const DisplayScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.black,
      appBar: AppBar(title: Row(children: [Image.asset('assets/kca_logo.png', height: 30), const SizedBox(width: 10), const Text("KCA NOW SERVING")]), backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0A2A6B)),
      body: StreamBuilder(
        stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('queue_requests').where('status', isEqualTo: 'serving').limit(1).snapshots(),
        builder: (context, snap) {
          var serving = snap.hasData && snap.data!.docs.isNotEmpty? snap.data!.docs.first : null;
          return StreamBuilder(
            stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('queue_requests').where('status', isEqualTo: 'approved').orderBy('requestedAt').limit(5).snapshots(),
            builder: (context, snap2) {
              var next = snap2.hasData? snap2.data!.docs : [];
              return Column(children: [
                const SizedBox(height: 50),
                const Text("NOW SERVING", style: TextStyle(color: Colors.green, fontSize: 40, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                Text(serving?['queueNumber'].toString()?? "--", style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 120, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                Text(serving?['name']?? "WAITING...", style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 40)),
                const Divider(color: Colors.white, height: 50),
                const Text("UP NEXT", style: TextStyle(color: Colors.yellow, fontSize: 30)),
              ...next.map((d) => Text("${d['queueNumber']}. ${d['name']}", style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 24)))
              ]);
            }
          );
        }
      ),
    );
  }
}
